purpose: Prototype source-of-truth dataset for YojanaMitra scheme matching and explainability.
important_rule: Use this dataset for prototype rule evaluation. Do not let an LLM invent or override eligibility rules.
verification_policy: Every scheme entry contains an official source and verification date. Re-verify official guidelines before production deployment.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
schemes.purpose: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up new micro enterprises and for specified upgradation of existing PMEGP/REGP/MUDRA units.

eligibility.existing_units: Not eligible for new-unit assistance if the unit is an existing unit under PMRY/REGP or another Government scheme, or has already availed Government subsidy under another Government scheme.

financial_assistance.bank_finance: Balance amount of project cost is financed by banks, subject to sanction and applicable rules.
financial_assistance.interest_rate: As determined by the financing bank.
financial_assistance.repayment: As determined by the financing bank and applicable PMEGP guidelines.

documents_required: Other documents prescribed by the implementing agency/bank
notes: The current revised guidelines found on the official KVIC portal state ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for service/business as the project-cost ceilings for margin-money subsidy.
Do not use older PMEGP figures such as ₹25 lakh/₹10 lakh in the application logic.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
schemes.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.purpose: Institutional collateral-free credit for micro enterprises and income-generating non-farm activities, including eligible activities allied to agriculture.

credit_purpose: business loan for vendors, traders, shopkeepers and service activities
eligibility.default_status: Applicant should not be in default to a bank or financial institution.
eligibility.tarun_plus_condition: Loans above ₹10 lakh and up to ₹20 lakh are available under Tarun Plus for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid a previous Tarun-category loan, subject to scheme rules.

financial_assistance.interest_rate: Determined by the lending institution under applicable guidelines.
financial_assistance.repayment: Determined by the lending institution and applicable product terms.

documents_required: Documents required by the lending institution
Other documents applicable to the selected MUDRA product
notes: The official Department of Financial Services page states collateral is not required.
Loan approval, interest rate and repayment remain subject to the lending institution's credit/risk policies.

schemes.name: Prime Minister Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.purpose: Working-capital credit and related incentives for street vendors, with progressive loan tranches and incentives for regular repayment and digital transactions.
schemes.geography: Urban areas and eligible surrounding peri-urban/rural areas

eligibility.primary_condition: Applicant must be an eligible street vendor under the PM SVANidhi framework.
vendor_identification: Eligible vendors in the surveyed list
Eligible vendors with Letter of Recommendation/provisional documentation as provided under scheme procedures
eligibility.kyc: Aadhaar and other accepted KYC documents as prescribed.

tranches.name: Second loan
tranches.condition: Eligible after timely/early repayment of the previous loan and subject to scheme rules.

tranches.name: Third loan
tranches.condition: Eligible after successful repayment of the previous tranche and subject to scheme rules.

documents_required: Certificate of Vending / Identity Card / eligible vendor documentation
Other documents required by the implementing process
notes: The scheme is specifically for eligible street vendors; do not recommend it to every small-business applicant.
Lenders still apply their own credit/risk policies.

schemes.name: PM-DAKSH – Entrepreneurial Development Programme
schemes.purpose: Entrepreneurial development and skill-oriented training support for specified target groups.

income_condition.SC: No income limit stated on the current myScheme eligibility page
income_condition.DNT: No income limit stated on the current myScheme eligibility page
income_condition.Safai_Mitras_and_waste_pickers: No income limit stated on the current myScheme eligibility page

eligibility.aadhaar: Valid Aadhaar required, subject to stated state-level exception.
eligibility.registration: Registration on Skill India Digital Hub required.

financial_assistance.training_cost: As per applicable Common Cost Norms or concerned board rules.

stipend.residential: Boarding/lodging may be provided under applicable norms; specific stipend rules apply to Safai Mitras and waste pickers.

notes: This is a training/entrepreneurship-support component, not a substitute for a business loan.
Use it in YojanaMitra's Support Stack when the user satisfies the target-group criteria.
